mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with FEDFUNDS declining month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate earnings expectations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with UNRATE > 5.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with both HOUST and RSAFS declining month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth exceeding 1.5% month-over-month signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals rising inflation that may prompt monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month FEDFUNDS increases and CPIAUCSL year-over-year inflation exceeding 2.5% signal active monetary tightening that raises discount rates, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases month-over-month and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with both FEDFUNDS increasing and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month increase in retail sales signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of months with RSAFS increasing month-over-month, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month industrial production decline exceeding 0.5% signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth expectations, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with INDPRO MoM < -0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
